content: libkrun v1.19.6 header+source: krun_start_enter never returns on success and exit()s the process with the workload exit code (125/126/127 init errors) so a per-VM helper process is mandatory. Implicit vsock enables TSI HIJACK_INET whenever no virtio-net is configured; disable with krun_disable_implicit_vsock then krun_add_vsock(ctx,0). krun_add_vsock_port maps a guest vsock port to a host unix socket (guest connects). krun_add_disk raw-only with read_only flag; krun_set_root_disk_remount boots from block device via a NullFs virtiofs (no host dir). krun_set_exec envp NULL copies host env. main branch is libkrun 2.0 with incompatible object API; stable-1.19.x is current stable. Repo moved to github.com/libkrun/libkrun.
